svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.27.9.4 Lapped Strip Siding
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.27 CLADDING

g.text: Gap at the butted ends sealed, or protected
The overlap is the larger of 1 mm per 16 mm of board width and the
minimum for the joint type. Values computed here from Sentence (2)
and rounded to 0.1 mm. The code does not print them.

svg.text: Hardboard applied in horizontal lapped strips
has not less than a 5 mm (3/16″) gap provided
at the butted ends, which are sealed or
The horizontal joints of siding described in
Sentence (1) overlap not less than 1 mm per 16
mm width of siding board but not less than 9.5
mm (⅜″) for matched joint siding or 25 mm (1″)
B, C and D to scale, at different scales. Table E values computed from Sentence (2), not quoted. Moulding shape and board widths are illustration only.
